messages.author: f28bbf1544c274f8
messages.subject: Define non-redundant QTL
parts:
Hi, 
For two different traits there is QTL on same LG but 1.5 LOD intervals (95% of confidence interval) are different e.g. for the first one it is 21 cM (64-13) and for the second one it is 38 cM (56-18). Can I say they are two different QTL or one? 

Kind regards, 
Mehedi

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Define non-redundant QTL
parts:
To test for two vs one QTL, you need to fit a multi-trait model, but R/qtl has no facilities for this at present.

karl
